theme: An open day — one appointment, then room to breathe.

needsAttention.detail: Your p1 on the Mike + Dan board, overdue since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out; a refundable hold booked now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: December trip — decide and book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: Your own deadline is Wednesday. Holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so a domestic shortlist with nothing to wait on is the safe default.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week gap is the window to drive Portland to St Pete. Setting the dates and booking the one hotel night locks it in before the window closes the 18th.
